name: elbow nerve problems overview
title: Tingling, numbness or weakness around the elbow: true sensory loss means a nerve; ulnar neuropathy at the elbow is worked up with Tinel sign, an ulnar sensory map, hand muscle strength and EMG/NCS, and managed with education, avoiding pressure and hyperflexion, then surgery; pronator syndrome compresses the median nerve at pronator teres

nodes.title: Tingling, numbness or weakness around the elbow: is it a NERVE, and which one?
lines: tingling can come from nerve, muscle, tendon, ligament or joint, or be REFERRED (cardiac?)
TRUE sensory LOSS is neurogenic: map it to one nerve's territory

nodes.title: ULNAR nerve, at the elbow
lines: medial elbow · ring + little finger

nodes.title: MEDIAN nerve, in the forearm
lines: front of the forearm · lateral 3½ fingers

nodes.title: Ulnar neuropathy at the elbow
lines: cubital tunnel syndrome
behind the medial epicondyle

nodes.title: Pronator syndrome
lines: median nerve between the 2 heads of pronator teres

nodes.title: Medial elbow pain
lines: • numbness + tingling: medial forearm into ring + little finger
• fingers 'fall asleep'

nodes.title: Causes
lines: • direct trauma ('funny bone') · leaning on a desk
• elbow bent in sleep · nerve slips on flexion

nodes.title: Pain + tenderness: top of the front of the forearm
lines: • ↑ sensation: palm side of lateral 3½ fingers + adjacent palm
• from muscle bulk: elbow overuse

nodes.title: 1 · Tinel sign at the elbow
lines: tap the nerve → tingling down its territory

nodes.title: 2 · Sensory loss: ULNAR territory
lines: NOT the medial cutaneous nerve of the forearm, NOT C8

nodes.title: 3 · Motor
lines: ± weak: small hand muscles most affected

nodes.title: 4 · EMG / nerve conduction study
lines: diagnosis + severity: irritation or damage?

nodes.title: Other median sites
lines: • cut in the cubital fossa
• carpal tunnel: see WRIST AND HAND PART 2

nodes.title: 1 · Educate
lines: neuritis AND mild neuropathy are fully reversible

nodes.title: 2 · Off the elbow
lines: • no leaning on it · ergonomics
• towel splint or elbow pad at night

nodes.title: SIGNIFICANT or PROGRESSIVE weakness
lines: act earlier → ulnar neurolysis or transposition surgery · drugs add little

panels.title: No true sensory loss?
items: think tendon (see the ELBOW TENDINOPATHY chart), joint, ligament or bursa (see the ELBOW chart), or referred pain

panels.title: Ulnar nerve at the WRIST instead?
items: Guyon's canal ('handlebar neuropathy'), less common than at the elbow: see WRIST AND HAND PART 2
